title: Phone app: a Stop button for spoken readouts, and new builds pushed to the phone from the laptop

fields.why: TJ cannot stop an audio readout on the Android app, and wants app updates shipped remotely like Nightmare Mode does

text: Phone app is in mobile/ (android, bridge, relay; see mobile/DESIGN.md). 1) Add a visible Stop control that halts text-to-speech mid-readout. 2) Copy the pattern of ~/nightmaremode/game/tools/ship_android.sh: build the APK, upload a zip-tested snapshot to a Cloudflare R2 bucket at a stable secret URL (secret in a home-dir file, not the repo) with a small download page, so TJ installs updates from the phone. Goal: phone-app.
